name: Ai Sdr Bdr Agent
headline: AI-Powered BDR/SDR Agent for Sales Automation
short_description: The AI-powered BDR/SDR agent automates lead discovery and personalized outreach, enhancing sales efficiency. With real-time CRM integration, it streamlines the sales process for better lead management.
author: brightdata

sections.overview:
The AI BDR/SDR Agent System automates sales development workflows using five specialized agents: Company Discovery finds ICP-matched prospects, Trigger Detection identifies buying signals like funding or hiring changes, Contact Research extracts decision-maker information, Message Generation creates personalized outreach, and Pipeline Manager scores leads and syncs with HubSpot. Built on CrewAI and powered by OpenAI GPT-4 with Bright Data's web scraping, it processes real-time data to deliver qualified leads with contextual messaging. This system targets SDRs, BDRs, and revenue teams seeking to reduce manual prospecting while increasing response rates through trigger-based personalization and automated CRM integration.
Automating lead discovery from various sources
Personalizing outreach emails based on contact research
Detecting sales triggers for timely follow-ups
Integrating with CRM systems for seamless data management

```
Act as an AI-powered BDR/SDR agent for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Use the provided [DATA] to identify potential leads and craft personalized outreach messages. Focus on [SPECIFIC GOAL], such as scheduling demos or gathering contact information.
```
